# Performance (baselines, metrics and targets)

For each proposed improvement, the current baseline with its provenance, the metric to measure, and the target or the decision still needed. Provenance: M = measured by a re-runnable script (here, render_spec over a diagram: a model figure, not a runtime one); R = reported by an earlier session or run record; C = read from the code. No target has been measured against a running Librarian.
